title: Quantum Dynamical Selection predicts effects in ordinary chemistry

statements.text: The selection rule implies a differential reactivity of para- and ortho-hydrogen, a new isotope fractionation mechanism, an account of the activity of reactive oxygen species and the quantum-to-biochemical link in the nuclear spin model of the brain.

sources.quote: the implications of the Quantum Dynamical Selection rule include: (i) a differential chemical reactivity of para- and ortho-hydrogen
